capabilities: apply colored borders to notes by rule
add, edit, remove and reorder rules in settings
extras: BRAT is described only as an optional manual installation method for unapproved plugins, not as a runtime dependency.
problem: Obsidian gives no visual way to tell apart notes at a glance by folder or metadata, so users cannot categorize notes by color.

relations.evidence: BRAT (Beta Reviewers Auto-update Tester) is a plugin for Obsidian that allows you to install and manage plugins

summary: Rule-based plugin that draws colored borders around notes based on their folder path or frontmatter metadata values.
